video.description: Use when the user requests video production or a storyboard sheet for a video, including partial video work such as shorts/reels editing, re-editing existing video or extracting clips, video captions and lower thirds, ad or promo video scripts, and motion-graphics style for video. Do not use for standalone writing (including turning a video into an article or post), social posts, standalone images, ordinary design, application development, or audio-only work.
